variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text: So now the wheel turns all day and grinds nothing! Those Urchins pulled the crank right off my millstone and ran off with it. Here, take this key. It opens the gate of the old barrow, east of the ford. If you bring my crank back, I'll see you're paid for it. Well? Are you going or not?

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My crank! At last! Take these boots, they're good in the mud down by the ford. And thank you, kind sir!

journal.text: Recover Wenna's millstone crank from the Urchins of the old barrow.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: The north gate is closed by order of Mayor Halvard. There are bandits on the north road. If you want through, you'll have to take it up with the Mayor himself.

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: Welcome! Arms and armor, and coffins for the Chapel when there's call for them. What do you need?

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Drowned Lantern, down by the water.

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: Shoo! Can't you see I'm counting my chickens? One... two... Aw, now I have to start all over!

variants.specifics: Thrumm: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Foreman Kessick
offer.text:
Attention! By order of the Miners' Guild, a bounty has been posted on the Giant Leeches of the Sump! These loathsome creatures have bled my finest diggers nearly dry. As if the Golems of Vorga were not horror enough!

The Sump is east of the lift. Here is the key to its gate. Will you go down there and destroy them?

completion.speaker: Foreman Kessick
completion.text: The Leeches are dead? Excellent work! The Miners' Guild always pays its debts. Here is your bounty, 100 gold pieces.

journal.text: Destroy the Giant Leeches in the Sump for Foreman Kessick.

guard.speaker: Tullis
guard.text: Welcome to Thrumm, stranger! Mind your head. Warlord Gorran is waiting for you in the Great Hall, straight ahead.

shop.speaker: Yselde
shop.text: Don't touch the scrolls with those filthy hands. Buy something or get out.

townsfolk1.speaker: Varn
townsfolk1.text: Well, look at you, all shiny and clean. Come see me when you've got some dirt on your face, hero.

townsfolk2.speaker: Fobb
townsfolk2.text: Oh.... The Golems come up the shafts every night now. What will become of us?

variants.specifics: Tharn: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ebbard the Herbalist
offer.text: Thieves! Rotten little thieves! The Imps got into my hut and ran off with my magic lantern! I can't go out picking herbs without it, not with Vuldra's Zombies all over the bog at night. If you bring it back to me, I'll pay you well, I swear it! Will you do it?

completion.speaker: Ebbard the Herbalist
completion.text: My lantern! You found my lantern! Oh, thank you, thank you! Here's your reward, 80 gold pieces.

journal.text: Recover Ebbard's magic lantern from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Pelk
guard.text: Watch your step out on the walkways, stranger! The planks are rotten past the gate, and the Zombies come up out of the bog at night.

shop.speaker: Morla
shop.text: Welcome to the Green Lamp, stranger! I saved my best room just for you. It costs a little extra, of course!

townsfolk1.speaker: Osk
townsfolk1.text: Leave me be. I've got nets to mend.

townsfolk2.speaker: Brug
townsfolk2.text: Mayor Dremmel is a good man, but he's too soft! Gundar the Ferryman would have run that witch out of the swamp long ago!

variants.specifics: Durnath: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Oh, not again! Every night the same thing! I climb up to look at the stars and I come back down stung all over!

Giant Wasps have nested in my observatory east of here. My charts are ruined and my lenses are filthy, and Lord Tavrin's soldiers won't lift a finger. They say they are too busy watching for Ostrigan. Would you clear out those Wasps for me? I will pay you well.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: No more buzzing! Listen! Not a single Wasp! Oh, thank you, thank you! Here is your reward, 100 gold pieces, as promised.

journal.text: Destroy the Wasp nest in Fennick's observatory.

guard.speaker: Torbek
guard.text: Greetings, stranger! Watch the sky on the north road. The Imps have been dropping on travelers all week.

shop.speaker: Hulgar
shop.text: Welcome to the Armory of Castle Durnath. Arms and armor for the loyal subjects of Lord Tavrin.

townsfolk1.speaker: Nessa
townsfolk1.text: Lord Tavrin is up in the keep, waiting on somebody. He's been up there for a month! If you ask me, he's scared stiff of Ostrigan.

townsfolk2.speaker: Pibb
townsfolk2.text: We let that Wizard live up on the hill for years and nobody ever asked what he was doing up there. Not once! Now look at us.

variants.specifics: Tullin: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Krebbit
offer.text:
...and that's the last time I leave a window open. Imps! Flew right in and grabbed my Pearl Amulet off the hook.

Their nest is up at the waterfall. You bring it back, you get somethin' for your trouble. Deal?

completion.speaker: Krebbit
completion.text:
That's it! That's my amulet!

Here. Take these boots. Go on, take 'em.

journal.text: Recover Krebbit's Pearl Amulet from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Bosk
guard.text: Want to spend a night in the lockup? Then keep walking.

shop.speaker: Sabeth
shop.text: Oh my, you look half drowned! Come in, come in. I have just the potion for you.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fishwife
townsfolk1.text: Everybody said don't bury the dead out on the island. Did anybody listen? No!

townsfolk2.speaker: Old man
townsfolk2.text: There's a light down under the water at night. Under it! I saw it myself.

variants.specifics: Quorran: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text: Bats! There are Bats in my study again! As if Malgrith and his Undead weren't enough! I can't read a single page with them flapping around my candles. So here's my bargain. You get rid of the Bats, and I'll give you a token of my appreciation. Agreed?

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: No more Bats? Oh, thank goodness! Here, please take this as a token of my appreciation. Now maybe I can finally get some reading done.

journal.text: Get rid of the Bats plaguing Fennick's study.

guard.speaker: Gurt
guard.text: This here is the tower of Archmage Corvald! No visitors allowed, and that goes double for Imps. You're not an Imp, are you?

shop.speaker: Bodge
shop.text: What?! Can't you see I'm busy? Ugh. Fine. A bed or a drink?

townsfolk1.speaker: Dobb
townsfolk1.text: The Undead are out in the Bone Hills. That's what everybody says. What's going to happen to us?

townsfolk2.speaker: Wendt
townsfolk2.text: If you're short on potions, smash a few barrels. You'd be amazed what people leave in them.

variants.specifics: Tor Vessa: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Steward Ormund
offer.text: Ah! A capable soul, at last! A grievous crime has been committed against this fort. The Imps have stolen the Amulet of Kesh from my very chambers and carried it off to their nest on the crags north of here! Return it, and I shall grant you passage through the Upper Gate. Will you undertake this task?

completion.speaker: Steward Ormund
completion.text: The Amulet of Kesh! Returned at last! Tor Vessa is in your debt. Here is your pass for the Upper Gate. Show it to the guards and they will let you through.

journal.text: Recover the Amulet of Kesh from the Imps' nest.

guard.speaker: Brask
guard.text: Welcome to Tor Vessa, stranger! No army has ever taken this fort, and none ever will while Lord Kessick holds the pass!

shop.speaker: Haskel
shop.text: What? You want a blade, buy a blade. I don't have all day.

townsfolk1.speaker: Ilsa
townsfolk1.text: Ooh! Are all the men down south as big as you?

townsfolk2.speaker: Petrik
townsfolk2.text: The dead walk on the pass at night. Grisla the Frost Witch calls them up out of the snow.

variants.specifics: Kildrun: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gristle
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. Everybody in Kildrun is fussing about the Ember Demons, and nobody cares one bit about my leeches! Giant leeches, big ones, crawled up into the cooling pools east of here. I can't fill a bucket without one of 'em latching onto my arm! You clear 'em out for me and I'll give you something useful. What do you say?

completion.speaker: Gristle
completion.text: No more leeches? Ha! I can fill my bucket in peace! Here, these boots are yours. Thank you, Wanderer!

journal.text: Kill the giant leeches in the cooling pools.

guard.speaker: Gorm
guard.text: Watch yourself, stranger. Troublemakers in Kildrun end up in Warden Krugg's lockup!

shop.speaker: Imbra
shop.text: Ah, a customer! My prices went up this morning. Don't ask me why. Heh, heh.

townsfolk1.speaker: Hilde
townsfolk1.text: Stay out of the Lower Forges, stranger! The Ember Demons are down there, and they burn everything they touch!

townsfolk2.speaker: Bolgo
townsfolk2.text: Ember Demons in the Great Forge, did ya hear? Bah! My wife's cooking is hotter than any Demon. Hah, hah, hah!

variants.specifics: Harrow Cross: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. Wipe your feet first. Both of them, please.

The Undead were rattling around my hut last night. Skeletons, a whole gang of them! I hid under the bed, and when I came out they had taken my Everlight Lantern.

Bring it back to me. And don't you dare scratch the glass.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: My Lantern! And not a scratch on it! Here, 80 gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Recover Fennick's Everlight Lantern from the Undead.

guard.speaker: Warden Krell
guard.text: Watch yourself in Harrow Cross, stranger. Start a fight at the inn and you'll be sleeping in my jail with the rats!

shop.speaker: Gilly
shop.text: Welcome to the Cartwheel Inn! Beds are upstairs. I make coffins out back too, if things go bad for you.

townsfolk1.speaker: Wenlow
townsfolk1.text: Stay off the roads after dark, stranger. The dead walk them now.

townsfolk2.speaker: Mungo
townsfolk2.text: Hic! The dead walk the roads after dark! Ever'body says so. Well, I walk 'em after dark too, and nobody runs from ME! Hic!

variants.specifics: Vardo: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Darvo
offer.text: Thieving, stinking, good-for-nothing Imps! They've moved into my granary south of the village and they eat my seed corn all night long and throw the husks at me when I go in there with a lantern, and the Mayor says he can't spare a single man because of the Ogres, and if this keeps up I won't have one seed left to plant come spring! Here, take this quiver. You clear those Imps out for me and I'll pay you in good gold. Deal?

completion.speaker: Darvo
completion.text: They're gone? Good riddance! Here's 100 gold, stranger. Thank you kindly!

journal.text: Clear the Imps out of Darvo's granary.

guard.speaker: Gorlen
guard.text: Hold it! Nobody goes out the north gate without Mayor Brumhold's permission. And keep that weapon put away while you're inside the village.

shop.speaker: Krell
shop.text: Welcome to Krell's Armory! Good steel at a fair price!

townsfolk1.speaker: Tibbet
townsfolk1.text: Somebody keeps leaving turnips on the well every morning. Nobody in Vardo will say who.

townsfolk2.speaker: Sorka
townsfolk2.text: I hear the Ogres are all over the north road. Take plenty of potions if you go that way.
